executionNotes: Initial system Python lacked jsonschema before discovery or traffic; switched to existing zap-product-assessment/.venv with required dependencies. No package installation or scanner changes.

Two analysis issues were diagnosed using captured responses: shared FoodDto stock is not cart ownership state, and an empty filtered page needs no redundant second empty page. Original HTTP and original analysis values retained in the working journal; corrected derived observations are recorded above.
